name: Gravita India Ltd
title: Gravita India Ltd - 533282 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Lead capacity expanding to 800,000 tpa by FY29 and Rs 1,700 crore capex, with peak working-capital debt of Rs 800-900 crore; copper ROCE and margin claims rest on unbuilt backward integration.

utilisation.quote: current capacity utilization is around 50% and we would want to take it to around 60%-65% in the next year itself

capex.peers_comment: Management said some competitors are adding sharp capacity in copper.
capex.quote: given some of the competitors are also adding sharp capacity in their segment

triggers.label: Capex plan raised to Rs 1,700 cr
triggers.quote: we have earmarked a total CAPEX of INR 1,700 crores through FY ‘29

triggers.label: Working capital ~90 days
triggers.quote: current working capital was for this year, including the copper part, was around 90 days

triggers.label: Aluminium volumes declining
triggers.quote: the aluminum segment witnessed a declining trend in FY ‘26 as well as on a quarterly basis

guidance.quote: we are very confident of getting a CAGR of 20%-25% in volume terms consistently over the next three years
we have earmarked a total CAPEX of INR 1,700 crores through FY ‘29
you can expect a volume of around 800,000 tons by FY ‘29 in terms of volumes
debt should be working capital debt of around INR 800 crores to INR 900 crores
it should be close to 85 to 90 days going forward

guidance.value: INR 65,000-70,000 per ton after backward integration
guidance.quote: it would go up to INR 65,000 per ton to INR 70,000 per ton in future
blended tax rate for going forward should be in the range of 17%-18%
on a sustainable basis, we have always said that it ’s going to be around INR 14 to INR 15 per kg
you can expect around INR 10 to INR 12 EBITDA margins in plastic going forward also
So, lead again is around Rs.19-INR 20 per kg

guidance.value: INR 4-5 crore for FY27 (per quarter ~4 crore)
guidance.quote: that INR 4 crores to INR 5 crores will be the interest cost for this year
ROCE should be in the range of 20% plus
we are not considering any volume from lithium -ion battery till our FY ‘29 guidance
